description: telemetry-schema.js:3-16 validates only the fixed field set and ignores unknown keys, so the additive fields (tags, revenue_by_source, log_feed) are never type-checked. R9 (behavioral-spec.md:57-58; 1b :72) only proves existing rows still pass and imposes no validation on the new shapes. A malformed tags (string instead of string[], or [123]) passes validation and is consumed by R7 tags.includes('agent-hackathon') and the Ours logic, which can throw or misclassify a security boundary.

evidence.snippet: function validate(o){...return {ok:true,payload:o}} // no checks for tags/revenue_by_source/log_feed
